description: An offline-first deliberative democracy platform for collaborative policy deliberation with spectrum-based voting, weighted role systems, and manual peer coordination via exportable share packs. Features real IndexedDB persistence, particle animation backgrounds, data visualizations, and zero-harm architecture with no tracking or telemetry.

name: regeneration_visas
description: A web-driven platform for designing, assessing, monitoring, and prototyping regenerative visa frameworks and immigration policy pathways. It includes calculator tools, dashboards, risk and skills assessments, precedents data, monitoring modules, and Indigenous and provincial frameworks — all integrated in a single AGPL-licensed repo.

name: polycrisis
description: A lightweight, open HTML entry for a project exploring polycrisis — the interlinked, compounding global crises spanning environment, society, economy, and technology. Built as a web hub to help navigate complexity and systemic risk with resources, insights, and interactive mapping of converging global challenges.

name: life_first_judgment_in_critical_protocols
description: Exploring historical cases where human judgment prioritized life over rigid protocols, preventing nuclear catastrophes. Highlights Petrov (1983), Arkhipov (1962), and NORAD (1979), showing how benevolent decision-making can outweigh non-life-supporting rules.
